campaign: V1 Phase B B.2'' substep 3 cipher_cdi_patch.py unit tests
purpose: Per V1 Phase B scope-lock addendum B.1'' discipline note (b): cipher_cdi_patch.py is load-bearing for Goal 5 contract preservation; 6 unit test cases must PASS before .deb build.

test_design.fixtures: Temp files generated per test; no writes to real /var/run/cdi/.
test_design.harness: python3 stdlib only (subprocess + tempfile + json + yaml); no pytest.

cases.name: clean apply on factory-default nvidia.yaml
cases.purpose: happy path; CIPHER mounts + env appended; non-CIPHER entries preserved
cases.details: 3 env entries (CIPHER_CDI_MARKER, CUDA_INJECTION64_PATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH) + 12 mount entries (3 substrate libs + 5 plugin files + 4 dist-info) added; NVIDIA's libcuda.so.1 mount preserved; NVIDIA_CTK_LIBCUDA_DIR + NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES env preserved

cases.name: idempotent re-apply
cases.purpose: running apply twice produces identical state; no duplicates
cases.details: env count + mount count identical between first and second apply; status dict identical

cases.name: revert after apply
cases.purpose: revert removes all CIPHER entries; non-CIPHER preserved; revert-twice no-op
cases.details: all 3 CIPHER env entries removed; all 12 CIPHER mounts removed; NVIDIA's libcuda + env preserved; second revert is a no-op

cases.name: apply with unrelated additions (sibling observability agent)
cases.purpose: fragment-aware: apply must not corrupt or remove non-CIPHER additions from third parties
cases.details: fixture has SOMEOBS_AGENT_VERSION env + /opt/someobs/agent.so mount; after apply both preserved + CIPHER added; after revert both preserved + only CIPHER removed

cases.name: missing nvidia.yaml
cases.purpose: operator-readable error; exit 1; no silent no-op
cases.details: stderr names file as 'not found'; mentions nvidia-ctk regenerate; exit code 1

cases.name: malformed nvidia.yaml
cases.purpose: operator-readable error; exit 2; no silent corruption (file unchanged)
cases.details: stderr mentions 'malformed' / 'yaml'; exit code 2; original file content unchanged

cases.name: no-write-when-unchanged (watcher loop guard)
cases.purpose: added at substep 4: cipher-platform-watch.path fires on PathChanged; if apply rewrites file with identical content, IN_MODIFY fires regardless of equality, triggering watcher infinite loop. Guard: skip _atomic_write when no changes needed.
cases.details: first apply changes mtime; second apply leaves mtime unchanged (st_mtime_ns identical); same property for revert-twice

cases.name: libcupti.so.12 host discovery + revert
cases.purpose: added at B.2''-R1 (F-B.3.1 remediation): cipher_cdi_patch bind-mounts host libcupti.so.12 at fixed container path /usr/lib/cipher/libcupti.so.12; sub-case (a) host present -> mount added, fully_applied=True with 14 expected mounts; sub-case (b) host absent -> mount skipped + stderr warning + fully_applied=True with 13 expected mounts (libcupti dropped from required set).
cases.details: (a) synthetic host libcupti at /tmp test path -> mount added at containerPath=/usr/lib/cipher/libcupti.so.12, hostPath=synthetic; revert removes by containerPath match. (b) CIPHER_TEST_LIBCUPTI_PATH="" override -> _find_host_libcupti returns None; mount skipped; stderr contains WARNING + libcupti.so.12; fully_applied=True with libcupti dropped from required set.

summary.verdict: ALL PASS - cipher_cdi_patch.py with R1 libcupti remediation; watcher loop guard preserved; multi-ABI py310+py312 plugin chain ships in same .deb

additional_sanity_check.description: Apply on a copy of real /var/run/cdi/nvidia.yaml (nvidia-container-toolkit 1.18.1-0lambda0.22.04.1 generated, multi-device structure with 3 devices + top-level containerEdits with 18 mounts + 2 env)
additional_sanity_check.result: fully_applied=True; env 3/3; mounts 12/12; all 3 CIPHER env + 12 CIPHER mounts added to top-level containerEdits; NVIDIA's 18 mounts + 2 env preserved

honest_residue: 1. Unit tests run against synthetic factory + unrelated-additions YAML fixtures. Real /var/run/cdi/nvidia.yaml structure verified via additional sanity check at end (apply only, no full revert test on real file to avoid side-effects on running pod).

2. Tests do NOT exercise the actual container-runtime CDI consumption (i.e., docker run --gpus all with CIPHER mounts honored by nvidia-container-toolkit and substrate firing in container). That verification is B.3'' Gate A/B/C scope.

3. cipher_cdi_patch.py uses yaml.safe_dump with default_flow_style=False + sort_keys=False; YAML formatting may differ slightly from nvidia-ctk's emitter (cosmetic only; semantically equivalent; nvidia-ctk re-reads its own spec without trouble).
4. Atomic write uses tempfile.mkstemp + os.replace; tempfile is created in the same directory as the target (avoids cross-filesystem rename failures).

5. PYTHONPATH override risk for non-standard customer container Python layouts is noted in cipher_cdi_patch.py via CIPHER plugin paths matching standard Ubuntu /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages; runbook §3 will cover non-standard cases (B.2'' substep 6 scope).

6. LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/cipher env set unconditionally (CDI does not support shell-style append); for vanilla vllm/vllm-openai:0.21.0 (no pre-set LD_LIBRARY_PATH) this works correctly; for customer containers that DO set LD_LIBRARY_PATH the CIPHER value overrides; documented as known edge case for B.3'' verification.
